segments.title: March
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! March is Main Character Month. Women's Day, Holi, and a whole studio full of people who deserve the spotlight. This month we hand it to them, and gently suggest they renew while standing in it.

segments.title: ₹1.74L
segments.text: So, the number. Our March target for Pop-up is 1.74 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent more than last March. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 95,500 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 76,400, and everything else 1,700. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 46 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 538 leads, 140 trials, and 46 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Two offers carry 76,000 rupees, which is 44 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The Second Date's On Us
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, The Second Date's On Us. First class at half price, the second one free, and the third? That's a relationship, with fifteen per cent off the first month and an extra freeze. The plan is 8 buyers at about 5,900, so 47,100 rupees.

segments.title: Same Time Next Week
segments.text: And finally, for pack regulars, Same Time Next Week. Nearly out of classes? Take the same pack again at fifteen per cent off, plus an extra week of validity so nothing goes to waste. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,200, so 28,900 rupees.
segments.notes: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, check sell-through every Monday and follow up every trial within a day. Week three, a mid-month check against the target. Week four, no March expiry leaves without a conversation.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's March at Pop-up. 1.74 lakh rupees, two offers, and 46 buyers to welcome. Everyone gets to be the main character. Our job is the plot.
